title: No current New Orleans influence on Chicago players; Ray Burke and Fountain
summary: Chace can name no New Orleans player copied locally, and sees no influence of Pete Fountain on anyone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: By... By... People you know around town. No. Certainly not directly. I can't think of anybody. Uh... You know... I can't think of playing, but it's awfully hard to tell. Uh...

The clarinetists we've heard around town have been largely Ray Burke by way of his recordings, and yet they're not very well known, are they? Would you know Ray Burke if you heard a record on which he was playing? I've had the pleasure of hearing him right here, where we're talking, John, but...
Aside from that, no. I... I think he... A record of his was played the other day on an FM station here. Mm-hmm. But... Uh... He has no...

Well, certainly he's not played as much as Fountain, and you don't feel that Fountain has... Uh... Uh... An influence, uh... In style, or in anything except, uh... Say... General jazz, uh... Overall... Effectiveness.
No. I detect no... Influence of Fountain's playing on anybody around. I... It's interesting to wonder about who influenced him. Uh-huh. But it seems to me that he's a... An accomplished...
